basic_profile.bio: An avid tabletop RPG enthusiast and a dedicated Game Master, I have spent years crafting immersive worlds in Pathfinder and Dungeons & Dragons. Based in Portland, Oregon, I split my time between my work as a software developer and my passion for tabletop gaming. Outside of work, I enjoy gardening and have recently taken up horticulture as a hobby. Typically online during evenings and weekends, I love sharing my gaming experiences and learning from others in the community. Happily married with two cats who often join my gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a computer science degree and over a decade of experience in software development, I have honed my analytical skills and attention to detail. My deep dive into tabletop RPGs began in college, where I started hosting weekly campaigns. I've developed a comprehensive understanding of Pathfinder rules through years of gameplay and active participation in online RPG forums.
